snippet.title: Freefall '95 Trailer
snippet.description:
Freefall '95 is a fast paced, arcade-like, 90’s inspired action packed fun! Play as a passenger on board a doomed flight stuck in a twisted time loop in the year 1995. Explore a wild time-bending narrative while stacking up trick combos, collecting items, earning coins, upgrading abilities and dodging debris!

Wishlist on Steam now by using the link below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4144510/Freefall_95/
